description: This delightful Matcha Oat Milk Latte combines the earthy notes of premium Japanese matcha with the creamy richness of oat milk. It's a perfect dairy-free pick-me-up that offers both invigorating energy and soothing comfort. Enjoy this vibrant green beverage hot or iced for a truly satisfying experience.

ingredients.notes: maple syrup, agave, or sugar, optional

instructions.title: Prepare Your Matcha
instructions.text: Gather your matcha bowl or a small cup, a bamboo whisk (chasen) or a small frother, and a fine-mesh sieve. Sifting the matcha is crucial for a smooth latte.

instructions.title: Sift Matcha Powder
instructions.text: Place the fine-mesh sieve over your matcha bowl or cup. Add 1-2 teaspoons of matcha powder to the sieve and gently tap it to sift the matcha into the bowl. This prevents clumps.

instructions.title: Add Hot Water
instructions.text: Pour 2 ounces of hot water (around 175F or 80C, not boiling) over the sifted matcha. Using water that is too hot can burn the matcha and make it bitter.

instructions.title: Whisk the Matcha
instructions.text: Using your bamboo whisk, whisk the matcha and hot water vigorously in a 'W' or 'M' motion until a smooth, bright green liquid with a fine layer of foam on top is formed. This usually takes about 30-60 seconds.

instructions.title: Prepare Oat Milk
instructions.text: For a hot latte, gently heat 8-10 ounces of oat milk in a saucepan or microwave until warm and steamy, but not boiling. For an iced latte, simply chill your oat milk. If you have a milk frother, froth the warm oat milk until it's creamy and foamy.

instructions.title: Combine and Sweeten
instructions.text: Pour the prepared oat milk into your serving mug or glass. Slowly pour the whisked matcha over the oat milk. If desired, add 1-2 teaspoons of your preferred sweetener, such as maple syrup or agave, and stir gently.

instructions.title: Serve and Enjoy
instructions.text: For an iced latte, add ice cubes to your glass before pouring in the oat milk and matcha. Serve immediately and savor the creamy, earthy flavors of your homemade Matcha Oat Milk Latte.

tips: Always sift your matcha powder before adding water to prevent clumps and ensure a smooth, velvety texture. This is a key step for a superior latte experience.

For the best foam and creaminess, use a barista-blend oat milk. These are formulated to froth better than regular oat milk. Also, ensure your water for whisking matcha is around 175F (80C); boiling water can make matcha bitter.
Serve your Matcha Oat Milk Latte immediately after preparation to enjoy its vibrant color and fresh flavor. For an extra touch, dust with a tiny bit of matcha powder or garnish with a sprig of mint.
